sources.snippet: This will load the model contained in models/large. The path_or_hf_repo can also point to an MLX-style Whisper model on the Hugging Face Hub. In this case, the model will be automatically downloaded. A collection of pre-converted Whisper models are in the Hugging Face MLX Community. The transcribe function also supports word-level timestamps.

sources.snippet: Whisper medium Model Overview Whisper is a pre-trained model for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation. Whisper models demonstrate a strong ability to generalise to many datasets and domains without the need for fine-tuning. The models were trained on either English-only data or multilingual data.
